def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    base = pd.DataFrame(index=pd.Index(entity_ids, name='product_id'))

    orders = db['orders']
    items = db['order_items']
    reviews = db['reviews']
    payments = db['payments']

    # ---- order-level payments (known at purchase time) ----
    order_payments = payments.groupby('order_id').agg(
        total_payment=('payment_value', 'sum'),
        avg_payment_installments=('payment_installments', 'mean'),
        has_credit_card=('payment_type', lambda x: float((x == 'credit_card').any())),
        has_boleto=('payment_type', lambda x: float((x == 'boleto').any())),
    ).reset_index()

    # ---- reviews: only those already written before seed_time ----
    rev_past = reviews[reviews['review_creation_date'] < seed_time]
    order_reviews = rev_past.groupby('order_id').agg(
        avg_review_score=('review_score', 'mean'),
        num_reviews=('review_id', 'count'),
        share_positive=('review_score', lambda x: float((x >= 4).mean())),
    ).reset_index()

    # ---- order items strictly in the past relative to seed_time ----
    rel = items[items['product_id'].isin(entity_ids) & (items['ts'] < seed_time)].copy()
    if rel.empty:
        # all-zero feature frame
        cols = [
            'units_sold_w1', 'num_orders_w1', 'total_revenue_w1', 'avg_price_w1',
            'units_sold_w2', 'num_orders_w2', 'total_revenue_w2',
            'units_sold_w3', 'num_orders_w3', 'total_revenue_w3',
            'units_sold_older', 'num_orders_older', 'total_revenue_older',
            'num_successful_w1', 'num_failed_w1', 'success_rate_w1',
            'avg_delivery_delay_w1', 'on_time_rate_w1',
            'avg_total_payment_w1', 'avg_installments_w1',
            'pct_credit_card_w1', 'pct_boleto_w1',
            'avg_review_score_w1', 'num_reviews_w1', 'share_positive_w1',
            'num_successful_w2', 'success_rate_w2',
            'num_successful_w3', 'num_successful_older',
            'total_units_history', 'total_revenue_history',
            'days_since_last_purchase', 'active_days_history',
            'avg_review_score_history', 'total_reviews_history',
            'units_growth_w1_w2', 'units_growth_w2_w3',
            'aov_w1', 'aov_w2', 'freight_ratio_w1',
            'has_history',
        ]
        feats = base.copy()
        for c in cols:
            feats[c] = 0.0
        feats['days_since_last_purchase'] = 9999.0
        return feats.reindex(entity_ids)

    rel = rel.merge(
        orders[['order_id', 'order_status', 'order_approved_at',
                'order_delivered_customer_date', 'order_estimated_delivery_date']],
        on='order_id', how='left'
    ).merge(order_payments, on='order_id', how='left'
    ).merge(order_reviews, on='order_id', how='left')

    rel['days_before_seed'] = (seed_time - rel['ts']).dt.days
    rel['window'] = pd.cut(
        rel['days_before_seed'],
        bins=[-1, 90, 180, 360, np.inf],
        labels=['w1', 'w2', 'w3', 'older']
    )

    # ---- leakage-safe status logic ----
    # delivered successfully: delivery actually happened before seed_time
    delivered_before = rel['order_delivered_customer_date'].notna() & \
                       (rel['order_delivered_customer_date'] < seed_time)
    # canceled/unavailable is known only if the order was approved before seed_time
    approved_before = rel['order_approved_at'].notna() & (rel['order_approved_at'] < seed_time)
    failed_known = approved_before & rel['order_status'].isin(['canceled', 'unavailable'])

    rel['is_successful'] = delivered_before
    rel['is_failed'] = failed_known

    # delivery delay / on-time: only for orders delivered before seed_time
    rel['delivery_delay_days'] = np.where(
        delivered_before,
        (rel['order_delivered_customer_date'] - rel['order_estimated_delivery_date']).dt.days,
        np.nan
    )
    rel['on_time'] = np.where(delivered_before, (rel['delivery_delay_days'] <= 0).astype(float), np.nan)

    # payment/review info is attached only for orders approved before seed_time
    pay_known = approved_before
    for c in ['total_payment', 'avg_payment_installments', 'has_credit_card', 'has_boleto',
              'avg_review_score', 'num_reviews', 'share_positive']:
        rel.loc[~pay_known, c] = np.nan

    def agg_window(df, suffix):
        g = df.groupby('product_id')
        out = pd.DataFrame({
            f'units_sold_{suffix}': g['order_item_id'].count(),
            f'num_orders_{suffix}': g['order_id'].nunique(),
            f'total_revenue_{suffix}': g['price'].sum(),
            f'avg_price_{suffix}': g['price'].mean(),
            f'num_successful_{suffix}': g.apply(
                lambda x: x.loc[x['is_successful'], 'order_id'].nunique()),
            f'num_failed_{suffix}': g.apply(
                lambda x: x.loc[x['is_failed'], 'order_id'].nunique()),
            f'avg_delivery_delay_{suffix}': g['delivery_delay_days'].mean(),
            f'on_time_rate_{suffix}': g['on_time'].mean(),
            f'avg_total_payment_{suffix}': g['total_payment'].mean(),
            f'avg_installments_{suffix}': g['avg_payment_installments'].mean(),
            f'pct_credit_card_{suffix}': g['has_credit_card'].mean(),
            f'pct_boleto_{suffix}': g['has_boleto'].mean(),
            f'avg_review_score_{suffix}': g['avg_review_score'].mean(),
            f'num_reviews_{suffix}': g['num_reviews'].sum(),
            f'share_positive_{suffix}': g['share_positive'].mean(),
        })
        return out

    feats = base.copy()
    for w in ['w1', 'w2', 'w3', 'older']:
        sub = rel[rel['window'] == w]
        if not sub.empty:
            feats = feats.join(agg_window(sub, w), how='left')
        else:
            feats = feats.join(agg_window(rel.iloc[0:0], w), how='left')

    # ---- global history ----
    g = rel.groupby('product_id')
    hist = pd.DataFrame({
        'total_units_history': g['order_item_id'].count(),
        'total_revenue_history': g['price'].sum(),
        'last_purchase_ts': g['ts'].max(),
        'first_purchase_ts': g['ts'].min(),
        'avg_review_score_history': g['avg_review_score'].mean(),
        'total_reviews_history': g['num_reviews'].sum(),
    })
    hist['days_since_last_purchase'] = (seed_time - hist['last_purchase_ts']).dt.days
    hist['active_days_history'] = (hist['last_purchase_ts'] - hist['first_purchase_ts']).dt.days
    hist = hist.drop(columns=['last_purchase_ts', 'first_purchase_ts'])
    feats = feats.join(hist, how='left')

    feats['has_history'] = (~feats['total_units_history'].isna()).astype(float)

    num_cols = feats.select_dtypes(include=[np.number]).columns.tolist()
    feats[num_cols] = feats[num_cols].fillna(0.0)
    feats.loc[feats['has_history'] == 0, 'days_since_last_purchase'] = 9999.0

    # ---- derived ratios / trends ----
    eps = 1e-6
    feats['units_growth_w1_w2'] = (feats['units_sold_w1'] - feats['units_sold_w2']) / (feats['units_sold_w2'] + eps)
    feats['units_growth_w2_w3'] = (feats['units_sold_w2'] - feats['units_sold_w3']) / (feats['units_sold_w3'] + eps)
    feats['aov_w1'] = feats['total_revenue_w1'] / (feats['num_orders_w1'] + eps)
    feats['aov_w2'] = feats['total_revenue_w2'] / (feats['num_orders_w2'] + eps)
    feats['freight_ratio_w1'] = feats['total_freight_w1'] / (feats['total_revenue_w1'] + eps) \
        if 'total_freight_w1' in feats.columns else 0.0
    feats['success_rate_w1'] = feats['num_successful_w1'] / (feats['num_orders_w1'] + eps)
    feats['success_rate_w2'] = feats['num_successful_w2'] / (feats['num_orders_w2'] + eps)

    feats = feats.reindex(entity_ids)
    feats[num_cols + ['units_growth_w1_w2', 'units_growth_w2_w3', 'aov_w1', 'aov_w2',
                      'success_rate_w1', 'success_rate_w2']] = \
        feats.select_dtypes(include=[np.number]).fillna(0.0)
    return feats
